description: Publishes the listing prepared by prepare_listing, after the user said yes to its summary question for THIS card: pass the dealId, the publishToken and confirm true. Never call it without that yes. The result says whether the listing is confirmed live (with its link) or submitted and not confirmed yet; say exactly that. A retry returns the same listing. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

confirm.description: True once the user said yes to this listing; never set it before that.
